channel.description: Latest articles from Paste Media Group (pastemagazine.com)

item.title: The Best Summer is Tamra Davis' personal scrapbook of rock music and friendship
item.description: Warmth and nostalgia power the filmmaker’s travelogue of a Beastie Boys, Sonic Youth, and Foo Fighters tour from 30 years ago. But, unless you were on those buses or attended one of those shows, the material can be difficult to connect with.

item.title: Zendaya's got a secret that could ruin a wedding in full The Drama trailer
item.description: The first of this year's three Zendaya-Robert Pattinson collaborations will arrive on April 3.

item.title: Paste Panel: Our writers’ favorite guitar solos ever
item.description: Staff and contributing writers choose their favorite guitar solos of all time, including licks from Television, WAR, Midnight Movers, and more.

item.title: Joshua Chuquimia Crampton’s Anata is a ceremony of noise
item.description: Paste Pick: Walking through open portals, the California-born Aymara musician rewires the compositional possibilities of guitar playing. His new album merits repeated listens.

item.title: Going broad and selling out, The Moment imagines the end of an Eras Tour
item.description: Charli xcx's mockumentary The Moment satirizes what brat might have looked like if she had tried to reach the biggest possible audience.

item.title: The best 4K and Blu-ray releases coming out in February 2026
item.description: 4K and Blu-ray must-haves of February 2026 include funeral dirges to democracy and journalism, modernist comedy freakouts, and Gena Rowlands.
